---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- read_csv("data/mallards.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    timestamp = lubridate::ymd_hms(timestamp),
    month = lubridate::month(timestamp, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
    month_num = lubridate::month(timestamp),
    year = lubridate::year(timestamp),
    season = factor(
      case_when(
        month_num %in% 3:5 ~ "Spring",
        month_num %in% 6:8 ~ "Summer",
        month_num %in% 9:11 ~ "Autumn",
        month_num %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter"
      ),
      levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Autumn")
    )
  )

write_rds(mallards, "data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  count(duck_id, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  summarise(
    min_latitude = min(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_latitude = max(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_longitude = min(long, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_longitude = max(long, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10
countries <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

mallards |>
  filter(between(lat, 47, 55), between(long, 8, 25)) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = countries, fill = "gray95", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_point(aes(x = long, y = lat, color = duck_id), alpha = 0.6, size = 0.5) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(8, 25), ylim = c(47, 55), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude", color = "Duck") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 4))
```
